text: APPROVE: Moving the per-item body into `ParseContainer` and replacing the loop with `Where`/`Select` removes the loop, the `continue` branch and the ternaries from `Parse`, so its complexity drops well below 15. Behaviour is unchanged: non-object items are still skipped, the mapping is identical, and the lazy enumeration still runs inside the same `try`/`using` scope. The code uses only APIs and helpers that were already in use, so I see no reason the build would break, though I haven't run it.
